title: Composed supervisory control: Branching item sorter sequence -> Pause/resume sequence with abort recovery

inputs.name: A_ItemPresent
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Item at inspection point

inputs.name: A_RejectClass
inputs.description: Subsystem A: Item classified for rejection

outputs.name: A_State
outputs.description: Subsystem A: 0 wait, 1 inspect, 2 accept, 3 reject

outputs.name: B_State
outputs.description: Subsystem B: 0 idle, 1 step1, 2 step2, 3 done

scan.initialization: fresh function-block instance for every test case

assumptions: The function block is called exactly once per PLC scan.
Inputs are sampled at scan start and outputs are checked at scan end.
Each test starts from a fresh function-block instance.
Subsystem A executes before the supervisory latch and subsystem B within each scan.
Requirements inherited from subsystem B apply only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE.
When subsystem B is isolated, its externally visible outputs take their type-safe defaults.

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_ItemPresent in wait A_State shall enter inspection.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: Inspection shall branch to reject when A_RejectClass is TRUE and to accept otherwise.
requirements.property: G((A_State=1 AND A_RejectClass) -> X(A_State=3)) AND G((A_State=1 AND !A_RejectClass) -> X(A_State=2))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_TransferDone in either transfer A_State shall return to wait.
requirements.property: G(((A_State=2 OR A_State=3) AND A_TransferDone) -> X(A_State=0))

requirements.text: Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Inspect, A_AcceptGate, and A_RejectGate shall be mutually exclusive and match A_State.
Subsystem A shall satisfy: A_Reset shall return to wait and close both gates.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Start shall begin Step 1 only when idle and not B_Aborted.
requirements.property: G((B_State=0 AND B_Start AND !B_Aborted AND !B_Abort) -> X(B_State=1))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Advance shall move Step 1 to Step 2 and Step 2 to done only while not B_Paused.
requirements.property: G((B_Advance AND !B_Paused AND B_State=1)->X(B_State=2)) AND G((B_Advance AND !B_Paused AND B_State=2)->X(B_State=3))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Pause shall suppress active step outputs without losing B_State; B_Resume clears B_Paused.
While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Abort shall return B_State to idle, suppress outputs, clear B_Paused, and latch B_Aborted.
requirements.property: G(B_Abort -> (B_State=0 AND !B_Step1 AND !B_Step2 AND !B_Paused AND B_Aborted))

requirements.text: While SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE, subsystem B shall satisfy: B_Reset shall clear B_Aborted only while B_Start, B_Advance, B_Pause, B_Resume, and B_Abort are all FALSE.
A TRUE A_Inspect shall latch CrossReady unless CrossReset is TRUE in the same scan.
CrossReset shall have priority, clear CrossReady, and isolate every subsystem-B output to its type-safe default.
Once set, CrossReady shall remain TRUE after the subsystem-A signal falls, until a later CrossReset scan.
Subsystem B may execute only while SubsystemBEnable and CrossReady are TRUE; CrossBlocked is TRUE exactly when SubsystemBEnable is requested without CrossReady.

provenance.origin: deterministic ordered composition of independently specified base behaviors
